Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) is a respiratory virus, first reported the year 2001. Since then, it has been described as one of the main etiological agents that causes acute lower respiratory tract infections (ALRTIs),so it IS NOT NEW .

nodes.text:
How do I take care of myself?
If mild 
Drinking lots of fluids to prevent dehydration.
Taking over-the-counter (OTC) meds like pain relievers, decongestants and cough suppressants to help your symptoms. Don’t give medications to kids without asking their pediatrician first

nodes.author: Rude_Fossil
nodes.text:
But if respiratory distress,  wheeze or discomfort meet your physician asap 
Precautions :- 
Personal hygiene, wash hands , keep a good mask at public place . 

Don't make chaos . Enjoy your winters. Thank you 😊
End of thread.
